findings.summary: The effect 'Either party to the block may remove it' contradicts operation.block.remove ('Caller is the blocker'; any other caller is denied) and the new entity.Block invariant 'Only the blocker can remove it'.

The precondition only requires that a block exists between the owner and the contact, so the Remove block control would be offered to the blocked party, whose call operation.block.remove always denies.
